I joined @RepAnnWagner in a letter to NBC urging them to air all footage of human rights protests captured during the coverage of the Winter Olympic Games.

Expose the #CCP.

Read the letter👇 https://t.co/ZsO4WvjnAq

It has been 900 days since Trevor Reed was arrested in Moscow. 

That is 900 days of detainment on the basis of a ludicrous trial, 900 days of inhumane treatment.

It is way past time to #FreeTrevorReed. I call on @KremlinRussia_E to release Trevor immediately.

This is a dynamic situation, and I advise everyone to stay alert to local news and officials and exercise extreme caution. 

My thoughts and prayers are with those affected, as well as the brave first responders who continue to fight these fires.

We are so grateful for @torchnet for all you do to keep our community healthy.

Rural hospitals are critical to access to care in TX-11. Excited to continuing working with my colleagues in Congress to prioritize the long-term viability of rural hospitals and healthcare workers! https://t.co/XrTsZfqELP

.@Riley_Gaines_: "Women deserve fairness. We deserve safety and we deserve privacy, and we deserve respect... It's disheartening to be in the position I'm in feeling like I'm asking for the bare minimum."

The intolerant Left's treatment of her has been unacceptable. https://t.co/svFlnVe21o

The CEO of TikTok’s lies to me and other members of Congress while under oath will not be tolerated. We are demanding accountability for TikTok’s reckless treatment of the personal information of Americans. https://t.co/iPpKyqagcE

Rural Texas understands the importance and hurdles of rural healthcare. 
On National Rural Health Day, let’s unite in applause for the dedicated efforts of healthcare providers, organizations, and all champions working tirelessly to ensure quality care reaches every corner of our communities.

I was proud to join my colleagues today to denounce the FDA’s dangerous and illegal deregulation of the chemical abortion drug mifepristone. We cannot allow politics to dictate healthcare decisions, especially when it comes to matters as critical as the health and safety of women. Thank you to @SenHydeSmith and Congressman Chris Smith for partnering with me in standing up for women's health and safety.

Camille and I are praying for Princess Catherine and her family. As parents of three young children ourselves, it is hard to imagine the difficulty of undergoing cancer treatment. 

Join us in praying for comfort and hope for their family and a full recovery for the Princess.

In yet another slap in the face to the rule of law, President Biden is now offering free healthcare to illegal migrants—a move that is not only unacceptable but illegal. 

I am proud to lead legislation BLOCKING this illegal policy with @RepFischbach.

Congratulations to @HouseAgGOP Chairman @CongressmanGT on the bipartisan committee passage of the Farm Bill.
 
I am pleased that the Farm Bill increases reference prices and boosts the affordability of crop insurance to ensure a strong farm safety net. It also builds on Republican work to crack down on the purchase of farmland by China. 

Farmers and ranchers feed and clothe our nation; the farm bill is good for all Americans.

.@SteveDaines and I introduced legislation to fully fund the “Rip and Replace” program, remove Chinese equipment from our telecom networks, and protect rural coverage. Read more👇
https://t.co/AsFwikXBYO

Congratulations to my good friend @RepCiscomani on the House passage of his bill, the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act. 

Proud to vote for this bipartisan measure to better the lives of veterans and their families!

Medicaid is a crucial lifeline for our most vulnerable, and unfortunately, unchecked Democrat spending has put the program's future at risk.

I am proud that through reconciliation, Republicans will strengthen, secure, and sustain it for the vulnerable Americans who rely on it.

Republicans are PROTECTING Medicaid for vulnerable, eligible Americans who need it by ensuring benefits no longer go to:

❌ Dead people
❌ Illegal criminals 
❌ Gender-affirming care for minors 
❌ Able-bodied adults who choose not to work 

Watch me explain here 👇 https://t.co/8HiMamIWQT

One of my top priorities in Congress is defending unborn life and the people who stand up for it. 

Proud to introduce the Conscience Protection Act alongside @SenatorLankford to safeguard healthcare professionals who follow their conscience. Read more 👇
https://t.co/2wuPvj6Crx

Yesterday, during a @HouseCommerce Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee hearing, I questioned witnesses on how Congress can tackle the pressing issue of spam and scam calls. For healthcare professionals, scam or spam calls can impede a critical call from the emergency room. Watch my full line of questioning below ⬇️

🚨 I just spoke on the House floor in support of H.R. 884, my legislation to stop noncitizens from voting in DC elections. 

Congress must exercise its constitutional right and duty to restore commonsense and accountability in our nation's capital. Watch my full remarks: https://t.co/61s8nKaC67

Chairman @RepGuthrie penned a phenomenal op-ed today to cut through Democrat lies and set the record straight on the One Big Beautiful Bill.

This historic legislation protects America's most vulnerable by strengthening and preserving Medicaid.

Read his full op-ed below:

Today, I proudly voted in favor the MilCon-VA appropriations package to ensure our service members are properly equipped and cared for. 

This package fully funds veterans’ health care, benefits, and critical VA programs, including funding for my top priority in Congress, the ACES Act, which passed the House and Senate earlier this year.

Our nation’s heroes serve with unparalleled bravery and selflessness to protect our freedoms, and they deserve nothing but the best in return.

Tragic news from Fort Steward base in Georgia. I’m thankful for the swift action of the first responders and medical personnel on base, and that the lockdown has officially been lifted because of their efforts.  

Join me in praying for the soldiers wounded in this horrific act.

I am thrilled that @POTUS just signed the ACES Act into law. This legislation is more than just a bill—it's a lifeline and a message to every pilot who has put on the uniform to protect our skies that we will fight to protect their health in return. https://t.co/ruZsVVhm1W

Many Texans live in rural communities, often experiencing barriers to quality healthcare access. We must bridge this gap, which is exactly what Republicans did by making historic investments in rural healthcare and rural facilities.   

Watch @SecKennedy explain our $50 billion dollar allocation to deliver for rural America ⬇️

.@HouseGOP's Working Families Tax Cut includes the single largest investment in rural health care in American history. 

Today, @CMSGov announced guidance on how to apply for its $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Program. Read more about it below:
